integrity: The proof is analytic. Numerical bisection and geometric intersection tests are reproducibility checks only and are not substitutes for the global argument.
scientific_limitations: The general chord-balance law is asserted only for local optima in the regular three-cap regime. The global uniqueness theorem is proved only for the displayed right triangle. No classification of all triangles by cap regime is claimed.
title: One-parameter exact Fraenkel center of the \(30^\circ\)-\(60^\circ\)-\(90^\circ\) triangle
